product_metadata.title: Mini Garlic Chopper Electric 2021 Upgrade, OBERLY Portable Food Processor 250ML, Garlic Mincer with 1500mAh USB Rechargeable Battery, Food Maker for Garlic, Onion, Chili, Parsley, Shallot, Ginger
features: ★High Performing Food Chopper: This Mini chopper fitted with a 1500mAh and 30W motor designed to drive 3 stainless steel reinforced blades that provide great performance for reliable results. As a compact and lightweight electric garlic chopper, this 8.5oz food chopper is perfect for small jobs, like chopping garlic, ginger, peppers, carrots, fruit，vegetables, onions, nuts and more.

★Easy To Use and Clean: One touch button to switch the chopper on or off , just fill the container with your ingredients, lock the cover, you can get an evenly shred food in a few seconds. The whole body of the crusher is waterproof and the blades are removable. You can directly rinse the food chopper after use, which is easy cleaning with no residue.

★Portable & USB Rechargeable: This 8.5oz food processor is taking advantage of compact volume, portable, space-saving, and handle the small needs in your life, and it is a great option when you travel or on camping trips. This food cutter support USB rechargeable and ti can be used about 35 times after fully charged.

★Premium Safe Material: This mini electric Garlic Masher adopts BPA free material that is harmless to your family. Food grade 304 stainless steel blades of the blender are more resistant to rust and corrosion. the blades are ultra-sharp. Please pay attention when assembling or disassembling. All the materials come into contact with food that is free of the chemical.

★Tips for use: It is recommended that you cut large pieces of food into small pieces before use. Don't pile up the bottom space. For vegetables/fruits with hard skin, peel it off first. For hard roots such as carrots, beetroots, celeries, etc. make sure to PREBOIL them or MICROWAVE them quickly first before chopping them using the chopper.
description: Electric Wireless Garlic Chopper - Good Helper for Kitchen!

Don't want the smell of garlic and chili to stay on your hands? Don't want onions to stimulate the eye of you and your family? Do you want to cook with your children and enjoy parent-child time? Don't hesitate! What are you waiting for? Let us use this garlic chopper together!
Just put food or ingredients in the mini food processor by hand, lock the cover and start with one click to quickly shred food. The bowl and the blades can be separated, convenient to wash.
The food chopper is powered by USB which can be recharged in a variety of ways, light and portable, you can carry and use it anywhere anytime.

Cordless use, compact and cute, keep your kitchen organized. This portable mini chopper is very easy to carry on any backpack. It is also the best gift for camping and travel enthusiasts, suitable for indoor and outdoor activities.

Product material: ABS machine, PC transparent material, 304 stainless steel 3 blades Battery capacity: 1500mAh Capacity: 8.5oz (250ML) Power: 30w Rated input and output voltage: 5V (V) Power: USB rechargeable, the charging time is about 3hours and can be used about 45 times Waterproof: all body is waterproof and easy to clean Switch: one touch button to turn on or off Function: cutting vegetables, minced meat, stirring, mixing
1 x OBERLY Garlic Chopper 1 x USB Charging Cable 1 x User Manual
